visual-hybrid-union-only.evidence: lexical-ordered candidate union, no rerank (rerank ablation)

decision.summary: Dense visual routes do not pay, but visual-hybrid-rerank beats lexical-render by 0.263 on the visual-hard slices (0.920 vs 0.657).
decision.declared_rule: promote_narrow iff the best dense visual route gains >= 0.1 absolute task-success over lexical-render on ['chart.appearance', 'chart.value_read', 'table.cell_grid', 'form.label_placement', 'layout.column_bind'] while holding text.easy_control within 0.1, with zero forbidden/stale/unresolvable dangers, all no_delivery probes clean, and per-page storage plus warm query latency inside the declared envelope; else narrow_rerank_only when visual-hybrid-rerank gains >= 0.1; else experimental at >= 0.05; else do_not_promote.

repeatability.method: scores serialized twice and compared byte-wise
